title: The Gilded Atlas
scene: At 1:45 PM, the gilded atlas vanished from the press table. Only the binder saw the frayed copper bookmark left on the floor.

suspects.name: Edward Norris
suspects.testimony: I brewed mint tea in the back room from 1:25 to 1:45 PM before returning to the press table.
suspects.alibiProof: The postman chatted with Edward at the back door from 1:30 to 1:45 PM.

suspects.name: Simone Laurent
suspects.testimony: I trimmed parchment sheets right beside the press table from 1:30 to 1:50 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: A client watched Simone trimming parchment beside the press table from 1:30 to 1:50 PM.

suspects.name: Clive Bennett
suspects.testimony: I browsed the front shelves from 1:25 to 1:50 PM—I never dropped any frayed copper bookmark!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned a frayed copper bookmark, and gold leaf flecks clung to Clive's cuff.

suspects.name: Mei Zhou
suspects.testimony: I swept the front stoop from 1:25 to 1:50 PM, chatting with passing neighbors.
suspects.alibiProof: The café owner across the lane saw Mei sweeping the front stoop from 1:25 to 1:50 PM.
